tool_signatures.name: --alias
tool_signatures.description: Test a database connection and register it as a named connector.

tool_signatures.name: --allow-empty
tool_signatures.description: Ingest a document file and store its chunks for ``doc-ask``.

tool_signatures.name: --dialect
tool_signatures.description: Ask an agent a natural-language question and stream the response.

tool_signatures.name: --foreground
tool_signatures.description: Start the embedding daemon in the background.

tool_signatures.name: --include-anonymous
tool_signatures.description: Promote positively-rated feedback into the verified Qdrant collection.

tool_signatures.name: --json
tool_signatures.description: Regression-check an agent's knowledge.

tool_signatures.name: --limit
tool_signatures.description: List cached questions and their generated SQL for AGENT_ID.

tool_signatures.name: --output
tool_signatures.description: Merge dbt model/column docs into a knowledge base (KB-side only).

tool_signatures.name: --paraphrase
tool_signatures.description: Run a synchronous agent query and print the result.

tool_signatures.name: --password-env
tool_signatures.description: Rotate the password for a registered connector.

tool_signatures.name: --port
tool_signatures.description: Show whether the embedding daemon is running.

tool_signatures.name: --thumbs-down
tool_signatures.description: Record thumbs-up or thumbs-down feedback for a query answer.

tool_signatures.name: --top-k
tool_signatures.description: Ask a question against an ingested document collection.

tool_signatures.name: --verbose/--no-verbose
tool_signatures.description: Run the Query Capsule pipeline over recent query history.

tool_signatures.name: agent_id
tool_signatures.description: Show semantic cache statistics for AGENT_ID.

tool_signatures.name: alias_name
tool_signatures.description: Set a short alias for a connector ID.

tool_signatures.name: connector_id
tool_signatures.description: Inspect a connector's schema and print a summary.

tool_signatures.name: connectors
tool_signatures.description: List all registered connectors and their aliases.

tool_signatures.name: id_token
tool_signatures.description: Verify an OIDC ID token and print the decoded claims as JSON.

tool_signatures.name: stop
tool_signatures.description: Stop the embedding daemon.
